verdict.rationale: Unstructured's pricing page offers deployment in your own dedicated instance or VPC, and a community member reports self-hosting the official Docker image without trouble. That counts as the product's own documented self-host path, but it appears to be an enterprise-tier offering, and the pack has no first-party self-hosting install docs. missing for 10: first-party self-hosting/install documentation, clarity on whether the VPC option is customer-operated or vendor-managed, evidence of self-host availability outside the enterprise tier, and parity of the self-hosted build with the hosted platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Deploy Unstructured in your own dedicated instance or VPC with multi-user access, full data isolation, dedicated technical support, and pricing tailored to your needs.
Built for teams of any size that need privacy, control, and security.
self-hosting the official Unstructured Docker image was pretty hassle-free
